description: Can't Sleep Tonight? | Raga Yaman Bansuri | 3 Hours of Indian Classical Sleep Music to help you fall asleep fast and stay asleep.

When your body is tired but your mind won't stop, let the bansuri slow everything down. Three hours of soft, breathy bamboo flute in Raga Yaman — the classical Indian evening raga for deep peace — played low and slow so you can put it on, close your eyes, and drift off without trying.
No ads for the full three hours once you're asleep-friendly — just continuous, gentle flute for deep rest.
Best for: falling asleep fast · insomnia · a racing mind at night · staying asleep · deep rest.
Put it on low, get comfortable, and let sleep come to you. 🌙
⏱ Best played 30-60 minutes before you want to be asleep.
